title: GuvFX Dataset Import Receipt v1
description: TIM-side receipt for importing a signed GuvFX dataset release. TIM is a READ-ONLY consumer (GFX-ADR-TIM-001): it verifies signature + hashes + completeness, then IMPORTs or QUARANTINEs/REJECTs; it never connects to a broker, modifies a release, or holds broker credentials. Synthetic/design contract under GFX-PKT-TIM-C1.

importer_identity.description: TIM's dedicated read-only, non-administrator consumer identity (an identifier only, never a credential).

completeness_verified.description: Release is COMPLETE and the signed READY marker was present and written last.

quarantine_reason.description: Non-null when import_state is QUARANTINED or REJECTED; null when IMPORTED.
